Patient: Emma Wilson

Review following knee surgery on 2 November. Fit to return to desk duties from 18 November. No lifting over 5 kg or standing for more than twenty minutes until review on 9 December. Home working on Tuesdays and Thursdays agreed.

Medical history: bipolar II, diagnosed in 2021. Current medication: lamotrigine 100 mg each evening. Reports poor sleep over the last three nights. No recent dose changes.
limitations: Synthetic example selected after trying four source formats and two pairs of tasks.
Complete local Python application preview; no live browser or provider request.
No model weights, thresholds or production defaults changed.
